description: Stop reverse-proxying a subdomain, so the edge no longer serves the backend or terminates TLS for it. The name stays registered on the account.

domain.description: Which domain to act under: 'makes.fyi' (the default) or 'agentdomains.co'. The same label can exist under each, so pass this whenever you are not using the default.

label.description: The subdomain label, without the domain suffix (e.g. 'myapp' for myapp.makes.fyi).

name: remove_proxy
